verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no audit-log capability, no tamper-evidence such as hash-chaining or immutability, and no streaming or export to a SIEM. The only related item is an unexplained homepage activity-feed mockup ("John created a session… Mike enabled 2FA"). It has no accompanying description, so it does not establish a documented audit-logging or SIEM-export feature. Rate limiting, admin actions and session revocation are adjacent features and earn no credit here.
